fields.reasoning: The intent names the hang: spawn's loop waits on childOutcome, which ends only on an exit, and a child that said done sits at its prompt with no daemon to close it. The engine already counts a done mark as finished and closes the session's pane at once (readyForUntil, agent, closeSessionPane), and session.done is documented as the agent's very last action, so ending the wait on it and closing the pane follows the existing pattern; nothing hangs on the close, as in the engine.
fields.statement: rhiza run spawn treats a child's done mark (rhiza session done) as the end of the child, as the engine treats it for a step with until_when = "done": the wait ends with outcome pass and detail "said done", the end is journaled, and spawn then closes the child's Rex pane itself (closeSessionPane), so the child's agent exits with no daemon. A child that exited before saying done keeps today's outcome from its exit. childOutcome, shared with stepRunner.Child, reads the done mark too, so a restarted driver's reconcileSpawns records the same end. A pane close that fails leaves the outcome as it is and is only reported.

fields.acceptance: go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run 'TestRunSpawn|TestStepRunnerChild' passes and covers: a child whose record has a done mark and no exit, with a Tab.Block, makes spawn return outcome pass with detail said done, journal the spawn ended with pass, and run rex block close on that block (ctx.Exec captured); stepRunner.Child reports such a child ended with pass; (failure case) a live child with neither a done mark nor an exit keeps spawn waiting (it sleeps) until a later poll finds it exited 3, then spawn returns fail with exit 3 and closes no pane; (failure case) a rex close that errors still returns pass and the journaled end; go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/(run-spawn|describe-golden)' passes, describe-golden after -update if the RunSpawnResponse outcome description changes, with docs/reference/cli.md regenerated by rhiza docs to match.
fields.must_not: Wait for the child's process to exit once it said done; fail the spawn or drop its journaled end when the pane close fails; change the engine's own step polling (internal/run/engine.go) or session.done; start or close anything from the daemon process; touch the network or a real rex in tests
fields.statement: rhiza run spawn ends its wait as soon as the child session said done (pass, detail said done), journals the child's end, then closes the child's Rex pane so its agent exits, with or without a daemon; a child that exits without saying done ends as before, from its exit.
